Belle Lin / Wall Street Journal :

 LangChain, which aims to help large companies build and deploy their own AI agents, raised $300M led by CapitalG at a $3B valuation, up from $1.25B in 2025   —  Alphabet's CapitalG led the $300 million investment into the startup as it targets enterprises with agent-development platform
